rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved sponsors: accredited colleges/universities (psychology courses with semester/quarter credit), APA and APA-approved sponsors, AMA-approved sponsors offering psychology-related programs; Act 31 child abuse courses from approved providers
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt (except the 2-hour child abuse training) if licensed within 2 years of the first biennial renewal; licensees by endorsement from other states have prorated hours (3.75 per quarter).
rules.carryover: Up to 10 contact hours above 30 may carry over to the next biennium; excess ethics and child abuse hours cannot carry over as those topics.
rules.audit_note: Certify compliance at renewal; keep certificates/transcripts for at least two bienniums; subject to Board audit. Child abuse CE must be reported electronically by the approved provider.

topics.who: All psychologists: Act 31 child abuse recognition and reporting, from an approved provider
All psychologists; cannot count toward the ethics hours

rules.notes: Biennium runs Dec 1 of an odd year to Nov 30 of the next odd year. Home study (incl. non-interactive webinars) max 15 hours; teaching max 15; professional writing max 10.
